text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Sega SC-3000 was released in 1983 as a home computer version of Sega's SG-1000 hardware. It included a built-in keyboard and supported programming, educational software, and games. The system used cartridge and cassette media and shared hardware similarities with the SG-1000 console. Although it was released in several markets, it was overshadowed by competing home computers and Sega's later Master System platform.
